title: Security Tooling Collection

facts.label: Projects
facts.value: SIEM-lite, phishing, packet, port, password tools

description: A collection of focused Python tools for SIEM-style log analysis, phishing triage, packet analysis, port discovery, and password auditing.

sections.title: Collection Overview
content: This collection turns individual security concepts into small, understandable tools. It includes SIEM-lite for parsing logs and generating alerts, phishing-toolkit for email triage, packet-capture for traffic analysis, port-scanner for service discovery, and password-auditor for password-pattern analysis.
Together, the repositories show a progression from protocol and input handling to detection logic, reporting, and user-facing command-line design.

sections.title: Why It Matters
content: The value is not only in the individual scripts. The collection demonstrates an engineering habit of breaking security workflows into testable modules with clear inputs, outputs, and limitations.
These tools also provide supporting components for the homelab and cyber-drill projects, where logs, network behavior, and simulated findings need to become observable evidence.
